question: Which special knowledge or practical experience is NOT a condition for being nominated to Rajya Sabha by the President of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Eloquence.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__ Key Points__**

__
 
• ​According to the constitution, The maximum strength of the Rajya Sabha is 250. But the current strength of the Rajya Sabha is 245.
 
• Out of 250, the president will propose** 12 members **from among those with expertise in** literature, science, the arts, or social services**, as well as up to** 233 **representatives from the **states and union territories.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **upper house of India's bicameral **parliament is known as the **Rajya Sabha.**
 
• It can have up to** 245 members as of 2022.**
 
• **Article 80** of the Indian Constitution states that the Rajya Sabha has a **maximum seating capacity of 245 members **(233 elected, 12 appointed).
 
• Members serve **six-year terms** that are staggered.
 
• The **vice president of India** serves as the **Rajya Sabha's official chairman.**
 
• The **Rajya Sabha's deputy chairman **is chosen from among the body's members.
